name: Medications
label: Dischord
lede: Devin Ocampo and Chad Molter had been swapping instruments since high school. After Faraquet they started Medications, made two records for Dischord in two years, and came back five years later with a third that put the harmonies out front.

eras.title: Faraquet first
eras.text: Dischord says Devin Ocampo and Chad Molter had been trading instruments and bands since high school in Los Angeles. In DC it turned into Faraquet, a trio of knotted, shifting songs that set up what Medications would do.

years.h: Ocampo and Molter form [[Faraquet|e866e006-4c80-4753-b53f-1bc5d88ccddd]] with Jeff Boswell
years.p: Devin Ocampo is drumming in [[Smart Went Crazy|d9c78028-a30b-470b-b964-2f85cab51cc2]] when he meets bassist Jeff Boswell there. With Chad Molter they start Faraquet: Ocampo on guitar, Molter on drums.
The View from This Tower comes out on Dischord in 2000. A year later the band is done.
years.xp: Dischord's bio lists singles and a split EP with Akarso before the album, and says the band broke up in 2001.

eras.title: Trio, Dischord, two records in two years
eras.text: Molter moved to bass, Andrew Becker took the drums, and Ocampo and Molter started over. Medications toured the US and Europe hard, and the second record was produced by Fugazi's Brendan Canty.

years.cap: Devin Ocampo on guitar and Chad Molter on bass, drummer behind them, at a Medications show, October 2005
years.h: Two Faraquet founders, one new drummer
years.p: [[Devin Ocampo|10bc183b-b6a8-4769-9e7a-0637d0f8a7a8]] takes guitar and vocals, [[Chad Molter|794c2243-0136-4627-887c-00749b81475d]] bass and vocals, [[Andrew Becker|2eb6962f-0d20-4d8c-896b-c5ac3613377e]] drums. Same partnership as Faraquet, instruments swapped again.
years.xp: Dischord dates the start to 2003 and says the trio toured extensively across the US and Europe.

years.p: Five songs, the debut EP, exactly as labeled.

years.cap: Medications on stage in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, April 2007
years.h: Canty produces the first full-length, Your Favorite People All In One Place
years.p: Recorded at Inner Ear and released as Dischord 149, the first Medications album.
years.xp: Ten songs, from Surprise! to Occupied, with Twine Time and This Is The Part We Laugh About in between.
play: Your Favorite People All In One Place

years.h: Ocampo picks up a second band, [[Beauty Pill|976b28a1-dd68-4c43-ba08-ba15b58963b2]]
years.p: Devin Ocampo joins Chad Clark, an old Smart Went Crazy bandmate, replacing Beauty Pill drummer Ryan Nelson. He's still there two decades later.

eras.title: Five years, then a course correction
eras.text: Becker left and Medications went quiet while Faraquet came back for a few shows. The 2010 return, with multi-instrumentalist Mark Cisneros, dropped the prog tangles and moved the harmonies to the front.

years.h: Faraquet play Brazil and DC again
years.p: Ocampo and Molter's earlier band reunites for a few shows. Dischord releases Faraquet's Anthology 1997–98 in 2008.

years.cap: Andrew Becker on drums, Medications, Belo Horizonte, Brazil, April 2007
years.h: Becker leaves, and [[Mark Cisneros|78448563-93ad-4d49-be7f-95bf5fe60021]] joins on keys and clarinet
years.p: Cisneros plays whatever the songs need. Washington City Paper reported that Molter covered the drums in the studio after Becker's exit.
years.xp: Dischord's bio puts Becker's exit during the recording of Completely Removed, with Mark Cisneros arriving as his replacement.

years.cap: Devin Ocampo singing and playing guitar at an outdoor show, March 2009
years.src: Dischord: Completely Removed · Washington City Paper
years.p: Devin Ocampo recorded the second album himself over several months, not live in a room, and stacked the vocals high.
years.xp:
It's Dischord No. 165, out in April 2010. Ocampo produced it at Treehouse, his home studio, and Dischord says the time let the band work on arrangements and production.

Washington City Paper called it "a course correction of the most tuneful variety" and one of the finest records out of the city's punk community in a long while. The reviewer noted that recording it this way made the usual Medications record, three people playing in a room, impossible.

Eleven songs, from For WMF to Tame On The Prowl, with Brasil '07 in the middle.

years.cap: Devin Ocampo mid-song on guitar, March 2009
years.p: Dischord lists the band as active 2003 to 2011. No farewell show is on record.

eras.title: Back to where it started
eras.text: Neither stopped. Ocampo kept playing with Beauty Pill and started The Effects, Molter went solo as Whisper States, and then the band from before Medications came back.

years.h: Faraquet are back, with dates all summer and fall
years.p: Ocampo, Molter and Jeff Boswell announce their first run since 2008.
